newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 18.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 18.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Opposition parties in the parliament demanded that the government should stop the privatisation of the electricity sector immediately.
- The government would like to halve the number of representatives in the governing bodies of the social security funds.

- The Foreign Ministry disagrees with criticism from the World Alliance of Hungarians and said the Hungarian-Slovak basic treaty provides approprate framework for improving the situtation of Slovakia's ethnic Hungarians.
- The police detained five suspects of a bombing committed earlier this month, while one suspect is still wanted.
